## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 1/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.82% | 1M: +26.79%) ↑ rising and HYG (1W: -0.91% | 1M: -1.36%) / LQD (1W: -1.77% | 1M: -1.69%) BELOW TREND show credit stress rising; cyclical vs defensive weakness (Cyclical vs Defensive 1W: -0.90% | 1M: -1.46% BELOW TREND).

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Credit stress rising: Credit Spread (1W: +1.03% | 1M: +0.24%) ABOVE TREND and HYG/LQD weakening. Fear elevated and re-accelerating in vols: VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.82% | 1M: +26.79%) ↑ rising.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Tighter conditions: UUP proxy (Dollar) inferred ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.76% | 1M: +3.17%) and TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -2.05% | 1M: -1.44%) ↓ falling — real yields pressuring risk assets.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Energy leading: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.82% | 1M: +7.33%) ↑ rising; Tech weak: XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -1.67% | 1M: -3.30%) ↓ falling; Financials showing notable weakness: XLF BELOW TREND (1W: -4.68% | 1M: -8.81%) ↓ falling. Style: Defensive/commodity exposure showing strength, Growth showing weakness.

5. US vs Global?  
US equities down: SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -2.24% | 1M: -3.77%) ↓ falling; Europe weak: FEZ BELOW TREND (1W: -1.54% | 1M: -8.01%) ↓ falling; China small bounce but fragile: FXI RECOVERY (1W: +1.63% | 1M: -8.53%).

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Speculation waning: IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -3.64% | 1M: -7.04%) ↓ falling, ARKK BELOW TREND (1W: -4.53% | 1M: -2.24%) ↓ falling, IBIT in CORRECTION (1W: -1.09% | 1M: +2.51%) ↓ falling.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Commodity bifurcation: Oil ETFs surging — USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +22.93% | 1M: +51.72%) ↑ rising and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +19.91% | 1M: +48.05%) ↑ rising; Copper weak: CPER BELOW TREND (1W: -0.03% | 1M: -2.09%) → flat.

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy dominant: XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.82% | 1M: +7.33%) ↑ rising and UNG ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.22% | 1M: +7.50%) ↑ rising — commodity-driven upside amid risk-off flows.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
CONFIRMED: VXX ↑ (1W: +9.82% | 1M: +26.79%) and credit metrics (HYG/LQD weakening) plus sector breadth 1/11. DIVERGENCE: Stocks vs Bonds ratio in RECOVERY (1W: +0.76% | 1M: -2.86%) — short-term bounce risk that could mask continued downside.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Reduce exposure to broad cyclicals and financials; favor energy/commodity ETFs showing strength (XLE (1W: +1.82% | 1M: +7.33%) ABOVE TREND, USO (1W: +22.93% | 1M: +51.72%) ABOVE TREND) and monitor credit (HYG/LQD) and VXX for volatility spikes.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: Energy — XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.82% | 1M: +7.33%) if oil momentum persists.  
BEARISH: Financials and broad cyclicals — XLF BELOW TREND (1W: -4.68% | 1M: -8.81%) and XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -1.67% | 1M: -3.30%).

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: Oil — USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +22.93% | 1M: +51.72%) and BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +19.91% | 1M: +48.05%).  
BEARISH: Industrial metals — CPER BELOW TREND (1W: -0.03% | 1M: -2.09%).

13. Key Levels?  
VXX elevated near current regime (monitor VXX above 30 for sustained stress), HYG/LQD ~0.73 signals credit-health watch, Breadth at 1/11 is the primary watchpoint for regime reversal.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF. Breadth: 1/11 sectors positive, confirmed by VXX ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.82% | 1M: +26.79%) ↑ rising and HYG (1W: -0.91% | 1M: -1.36%) / LQD (1W: -1.77% | 1M: -1.69%) BELOW TREND showing credit stress. Energy/commodities (XLE, USO) are showing strength while Tech (XLK) and Financials (XLF) are showing weakness; monitor Stocks vs Bonds RECOVERY (1W: +0.76% | 1M: -2.86%) as a potential short-lived offset.
